safety_contract: Pages keeps workflow_dispatch as the manual fallback.
Push, pull_request and schedule triggers remain forbidden for Pages.
Issue-triggered deployment is accepted only when the repository owner opens an issue titled [deploy-pages].
The issue body must contain an authorized_sha line exactly equal to the main SHA captured by GitHub for the event.
The public artifact is generated from the exact authorized commit without a live Notion read.
The complete public browser suite runs locally before deploy and again against GitHub Pages after deploy.
No workflow in this scope writes to Notion or closes editorial traceability.

audit_basis.reason: Permitir operação técnica pelo assistente sem exigir que o usuário opere o GitHub, preservando autorização explícita, SHA exato e gates de validação.
